results.title: My challenging and eye-opening journey to Mount Washington – Massachusetts Daily Collegian
results.content:
### Friday

A quiet excitement pervaded the air outside the University of Massachusetts Amherst gear locker. At 4 p.m. I departed for the weekend cabin trip to Bethlehem, N.H., with the UMass Outing Club (UMOC). Even for the exceptional trip about to take place, we had a delayed departure. By 4:30 p.m., a gang of three and I were on the road. [...] UMass Outing Club’s hike up the mountain proved to be a true adventure

Courtesy of John Manard on Flickr

Courtesy of John Manard on Flickr

Byline photo of Isaac Brickman

By Isaac Brickman, Head Graphics Editor

December 18, 2023

### Friday [...] A mellow ride home and a stop for a latte ended my trip. Arriving back at UMass, I was happy I got to have such an experience. I know many other people who went to the cabin surely did not go for the same reasons, experience the same things, or have the same takeaways. In my mind, that is one of the reasons I loved my trip.

results.title: UMass Chan-Lahey puts leadership and community at the heart of physician training
results.content:
In college, she was president of the Dartmouth Outing Club, the largest and oldest collegiate outing club in the country, and discovered a passion for managing its complex organizational challenges. She also enjoyed tackling staffing issues as a supervisor for the Saturday morning shift of the Dartmouth Ski Patrol, a role that required navigating strong personalities to keep the mountain open.
